transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we're here to finalize our review of the proposed $6,000,000 commitment to Northbridge Private Credit Fund IV. Before I make my decision, I need to hear from compliance and fund operations on any issues or execution requirements. The fund accepts commitments until the end of the month, so we have some time, but I want to make sure we've done our full pre-signing review. Could compliance and fund operations please report their findings?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag an important compliance issue. I received a policy amendment in this morning's compliance circular that has not yet been circulated to the investment committee. The amendment caps our company's commitment to this fund strategy at exactly $5,000,000, requires qualified-purchaser certification before signing, and requires quarterly look-through reporting. This directly impacts the proposed $6,000,000 commitment, as it would exceed the new cap by $1,000,000.
